transcription.original: ਇਹ ਫੁਲਕਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਦੁਪੱਟਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਅਸੀਂ ਹੱਥ ਨਾਲ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੂਤੀ ਕੱਪੜਾ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾਲ ਤੇ ਪੀਲੇ ਰੰਗ ਦੀ ਕਢਾਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।

translation.english: This is a Phulkari dupatta. We made it by hand. It uses cotton fabric and has red and yellow embroidery.

listing.title: Handcrafted Phulkari Cotton Dupatta with Red and Yellow Embroidery
listing.short_description: A hand-embroidered Phulkari dupatta crafted from cotton with vibrant red and yellow threadwork.
listing.description:
This dupatta is handcrafted using the traditional Phulkari embroidery technique. Made from cotton fabric, it features detailed red and yellow embroidery that is applied entirely by hand.

The piece reflects the skilled handwork of its artisan, with each stitch placed carefully across the fabric.
